description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans ClusterClient connection retries, specifically testing the retry logic and gateway list provider within a test cluster environment.

classes.name: ClusterClientTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans ClusterClient connection retry logic within a testing cluster environment.

classes.name: MockGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Mock implementation of IGatewayListProvider used to simulate gateway availability for testing connection retries.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster, setting the connection transport to TCP Socket.

methods.name: ConnectIsRetryableTest
methods.description: Asynchronously tests that the ClusterClient's connect operation is retryable by simulating gateway unavailability and reconfiguration.

methods.name: RetryFunc
methods.description: A retry predicate function that handles exceptions during connection attempts, specifically handling SiloUnavailableException and updating gateway list.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider; in mock, completes immediately.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Retrieves the list of gateway URIs from the provider.
